verdict.first_step_1: Install PostgreSQL 17 using Homebrew (brew install postgresql@17).
verdict.first_step_2: Search Homebrew for available PostgreSQL versions (brew search postgresql@) and install the latest version via a shell variable.
verdict.reason: Reply 1 provides a practical, straightforward self-signed certificate setup with working commands, whereas Reply 2 overcomplicates local development with a multi-step custom CA infrastructure and relies on an unreleased version default and fragile shell variables.
